text:
rachel: Heads-up — APAC marketplace listing next Tue. Need owners for press embargo, localized swap, SI quickstarts, and HW asset gating. Can we align timeline here?

ben: I can own press + media list. Draft PR in Drive: https://drive.google.com/marketplace-apac-v3. Need partner quotes from SI-Alpha + SI-Beta.

icarus: I'll own microsite swap and tile rendering. Prepare feature flag: marketplace_apac_live. Cutover steps: CDN purge -> flag flip -> smoke tests.

tia: I'll coordinate partner legal signoffs and co-brand approvals. One HW partner (HW-K9) requested limited hero use (web only).

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance window 6412348000 — no releases allowed during window.

rachel: Thanks ops-bot — keep swap before that. Proposed timing: embargo lift 09:00 PT -> 01:00 SGT, blog 01:10 SGT, microsite swap 01:20 SGT, partner emails 01:30 SGT. Thoughts?

ben: Suggest moving embargo lift 15m earlier than blog for APAC desks. Propose lift 00:55 SGT, blog 01:10 SGT, swap 01:25 SGT. Also adding UTMs: utm_source=partner_marketplace&utm_campaign=apac_launch.

icarus: Sequence OK. I'll set Cache-Control: no-cache on swap endpoints and run targeted CDN invalidation for /marketplace/* after swap. Dry-run planned for staging 60m before.

tia: Legal status: SI-Alpha OK, SI-Beta OK, HW-K9 pending (requested updated asset + signed MOU). If not signed by EOD APAC we show a placeholder tile.

ben: I'll add a short media one-pager and include UTM links and partner contact lines.

icarus: Cutover script snippet for ops:
```bash
# flip flag
curl -X POST "https://ops.redwood.com/flags" -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLAG" -d '{"flag":"marketplace_apac_live","state":"on"}'
# CDN invalidate
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id EXXXXXXX --paths "/marketplace/*"
```
I'll run this from the dry-run slot.

ops-bot: Pre-cutover checks: asset pack presence, feature flag toggle, smoke test hooks. Job id: mc-2026-07-08-11 queued.

rachel: Rollback plan = flip flag off + CDN purge fallback, and we keep a 20m rollback window. Jorge on-call? (pinging eng-oncall)

ben: Media outreach plan: embargo email to top APAC tech desks (plaintext + attachments). Will include clear delivery channels (email/presswire/partner-liaison).

tia: I've escalated HW-K9 legal contact. If no signed asset by final cutover we will replace hero card with "Partner coming soon" and show integration detail page when available.

icarus: I'll prepare placeholder component in design system for quick swap. Also will verify mobile tile appearances.

ben: Growth asked for token-level cost delta monitoring. I'll include utm tags and notify growth to watch acquisition funnels.

ops-bot: On-call rota: eng-oncall primary = jasmine, secondary = ram. Pager rules active during cutover.

rachel: Owners recap: rachel (overall), ben (press + UTMs), icarus (microsite + cutover), tia (legal + partner signoffs). Reply when your item is done. :white_check_mark:

ben: Press kit updated with UTMs and partner quotes (SI-Alpha). SI-Beta quote pending. Sending embargo table in 10m.

icarus: Dry-run on staging succeeded; found one CSS flicker on mobile tiles, fixed. Final dry-run 30m prior.

tia: HW-K9 approved at 23:40 PT. Asset pack uploaded to S3 and Drive with usage constraints noted.

ben: Sent embargo timings to media list. Included UTMs and contact lines.

icarus: Running final smoke at 01:10 SGT. Checks: GET /marketplace (200 + hero), GET /partner/{id} (200 + logo), 5xx < 0.5%.

ops-bot: Reminder: maintenance 6412348000 — confirm cutover completes before then.

rachel: Final check before go: 1) legal assets (tia) 2) press kit + UTMs (ben) 3) staging dry-run green (icarus) 4) on-call monitoring (ops-bot). Reply here when green.

ben: Green from press side. Kit live.

tia: Legal green. Assets uploaded and usage constraints documented.

icarus: Dry-run green. Runbook posted to #eng-oncall. Executing cutover at scheduled time.

rachel: Launch in 5. Moving comms to #launch-room. This Slack thread archived as launch choreography. Good luck team! :rocket:
